notes: The Studio gets its DAW heart: a new Tracks page — a groovebox-style loop where every track plays in sync at your tempo. Add Drums (synthesized 808/909 kit with a step sequencer), Synths (four voices with cutoff/attack/release/glide controls and a piano roll colored by YOUR key's scale degrees), or Samplers (load any audio file, set its root note, play it across the keys). Per-track mute/solo/volume and an FX slot (reverb, delay, drive). Arm a track LIVE and your ROLI or typing keys play its instrument — with slide and pressure. Ideas now have a 'To track' button, and Export WAV renders your loop to a real audio file. All ported from the OpenStudio engine.
